name: Path's Respite
desc: Located in Lower Erisia consisting of 5 buildings, a job board, next to a cave, with another room, an item locker and a way behind the mountain. The place used to be overrun by bandits, but now is only occupied by an [Antiques Smuggler](entity:antiques_smuggler) who will buy items for half the price of a standard antiquarian. Climbing above, you will find the [Temple of the Forgotten Flame](location:the_temple_of_the_forgotten_flame)
additional_info: -   This location used to be called the "Bandit Camp" by the community, as it had multiple set spawns for bandit captains
